counterevidence.held: The dashed preview leaves the sling and falls steeply to the lower right, although the pull sends the bird up and right.

evaluationScope: Preview versus launch only, from one recorded pull. This is a natural pair of two independently written games, not a patched pair; do not score differences in art, layout or level content.
